# Fathur Portfolio

> Portfolio website of Agus Fathurrahman Rifai (Fathur) — UI/UX Designer & Frontend Developer based in Malang, Indonesia. IT student at Universitas Brawijaya specializing in UI/UX Design, Frontend Development (React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP animation), and Graphic Design (poster event, branding, apparel design).

This single-page personal portfolio showcases web development projects, graphic & apparel design work, professional experience, and skills. Built with React, GSAP, and Tailwind CSS.

## Sections

- [Home](https://portofathur.my.id/): Portfolio landing page — UI/UX Designer & Frontend Developer
- [About](https://portofathur.my.id/#about): Background, education at Universitas Brawijaya, journey from Jakarta to Malang
- [Skills](https://portofathur.my.id/#skills): React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Figma, Adobe Illustrator, web design
- [Experience](https://portofathur.my.id/#experience): Provoks Multimedia, PKKMB Universitas Brawijaya, internships
- [Projects](https://portofathur.my.id/#projects): Web development, UI/UX design, poster event design, apparel design portfolio
- [Contact](https://portofathur.my.id/#contact): Email, phone, and social links

## Services

- UI/UX Design & Frontend Development (React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS)
- Web design & animated web experiences (GSAP, ScrollTrigger, Lenis)
- Graphic design: poster event, branding, social media design (jasa desain poster)
- Apparel & merchandise design: kaos komunitas, varsity jacket, bomber jacket
